##### Project general facts

Manarat Living III is the final chapter of Aldar’s acclaimed Manarat Living community on Saadiyat Island, offering a contemporary collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. Designed for those who value creativity and self-expression, the development embraces a design-led philosophy that encourages residents to personalize their homes while enjoying an inspiring setting at the heart of Abu Dhabi’s cultural district. Surrounded by iconic landmarks and thoughtfully crafted architecture, Manarat Living III delivers a lifestyle where individuality and modern living come together seamlessly.

Residents enjoy an exceptional selection of lifestyle amenities created to inspire wellness, creativity, and connection. Whether unwinding in the tranquil Zen Garden, enjoying an evening at the Rooftop Cinema, or spending time in the Gaming Room, every space is designed to enrich everyday life. The development also benefits from spectacular views of Manarat Al Saadiyat, the distinctive architecture of Berklee Abu Dhabi, and the island’s pristine white-sand beaches, placing culture, entertainment, and nature within easy reach.

The residences feature contemporary interiors with high-quality finishes and flexible design options that allow homeowners to choose between light and dark interior themes, creating spaces that reflect their own personal style. Thoughtfully planned layouts maximize comfort and natural light, while fully equipped kitchens provide everyday functionality within elegant, unfurnished homes. Manarat Living III offers a refined balance of modern design, personalization, and effortless island living in one of Abu Dhabi’s most inspiring destinations.

##### Location description and benefits

Saadiyat Island, nestled in the heart of Abu Dhabi, seamlessly blends cultural richness with natural beauty. This sought-after destination is renowned for its iconic landmarks, including the globally acclaimed Louvre Abu Dhabi, making it a cultural haven. The island offers a harmonious lifestyle, with upscale residences, pristine beaches, and world-class educational institutions.

The Cultural District stands as a testament to artistic excellence, featuring museums and exhibitions that celebrate the beauty of human creativity. Moreover, Saadiyat Island hosts luxurious hotels and resorts, providing residents and visitors with opulent accommodations and unparalleled hospitality.

Beyond its cultural and artistic significance, Saadiyat Island is a thriving community, offering a tranquil escape from the bustling city life. With a commitment to sustainability and a focus on creating a holistic living experience, Saadiyat Island is a unique and highly desirable destination, embodying the essence of art, education, and leisure.
